text:
Maya: ok folks — I'm opening a quick thread to track handoff templates + CLI snippets for the dedicated provisioning docs. want a tiny checklist we can drop into the migration guide and the onboarding playbook.

Kevin: SG. Is this for both reserved-pool migration and new tenant provisioning?

Maya: yes. two short variants: (1) migration checklist (assume existing tenants, plan downtime windows) and (2) new tenant quickstart (no infra to migrate). keep them < 12 steps.

DocBot: FYI: created PR draft docs#1103 with a new /docs/dedicated/handbook/handoff.md — needs content.

Ashley: I'll take the migration checklist. want me to include the autoscale policy snippet too? we had confusion last week about scale-out thresholds.

Maya: please include an example autoscale policy and a note about SLA impact if min replicas < X. we should reference the SLA matrix page. Also add a small note on isolation decorators.

Tom: pinging operations: @Kevin can you confirm the recommendation for min_replicas for production tenants? I think it's 2 for HA unless they're on dedicated-standby plan.

Kevin: correct — recommend min_replicas: 2 for production. add a sentence: "setting min_replicas to 1 will degrade SLA to best-effort and may trigger cold-start latency." :warning:

Ashley: adding a short YAML snippet for autoscale, will keep it minimal.

Chris: Heads-up: a few links in the existing migration guide 1729999999 are 404. I'll paste fixes here so you can slot them into the doc instead of hunting.

Chris: fixed links — replace /docs/old/dedicated-reserved with /docs/dedicated/reserved-capacity and /docs/old/isl with /docs/dedicated/isolation-decorators.

Ashley: adding the snippet now. draft below — want feedback on wording and whether to show both k8s HPA and our CLI config.

Ashley: ```yaml
# example autoscale policy for Dedicated
policy:
  type: cpu_and_queue
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 20
  scale_out_threshold: 0.75
  scale_in_threshold: 0.30
  cooldown_seconds: 120
```

Maya: looks good. can we also include the CLI equivalent (for infra teams that use our CLI during provisioning)? e.g., `redwood dedicated create-policy --min 2 --max 20 --scale-out 0.75`

Ashley: done. adding CLI example and a one-liner about SLA: "min_replicas < 2 may remove 99.9% latency guarantee."

Kevin: nit: change `scale_out_threshold` to `scale_out_ratio` to match SDK naming. small but important for copy+paste.

Ashley: updated. new snippet below: ```yaml
policy:
  type: cpu_and_queue
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 20
  scale_out_ratio: 0.75
  scale_in_ratio: 0.30
  cooldown_seconds: 120
```

Maya: great. Chris — can you run the quick link pass on the new handoff.md and migration checklist? I added TODO anchors where the link fixes should go.

Chris: will do in a few. also found an old SDK snippet that references `redwood-dedicated` package name; I'll swap to `@redwood/dedicated` in the snippets.

DocBot: Reminder: staging deploy of docs site scheduled 1743220600; merging this after linkfix will publish to staging for SME review.

Maya: timeline — Ashley, aim to push the update by EOD so Chris can review tomorrow AM before staging.

Ashley: on it. will open a small PR and tag docs reviewers and infra. PR title: "handbook: dedicated handoff templates + autoscale CLI snippets"

Kevin: add a short migration rollback step (how to revert to previous reserve settings) — we had a customer who had to rollback urgently last quarter.

Ashley: added rollback step and a short command: `redwood dedicated set-policy --id <policy-id> --rollback-to <commit>` in the checklist. noted that rollback requires tenant-admin perms.

Maya: perfect. last ask — can we include a 1-paragraph note on isolation decorators and eviction behavior? simple link to the isolation-decorators doc should suffice.

Chris: done. inserted link + one-liner: "Isolation decorators tag a tenant's workload to avoid noisy neighbor preemption; when eviction occurs, workloads are moved to fallback pool per routing policy."

DocBot: PR 1103 updated with Ashley's changes and link fixes. Staging scheduled.

Maya: thanks all — after staging review, we'll copy the checklist into the onboarding playbook and the quickstart. tagging @docs for visibility. :thumbsup:

Kevin: thanks — will review the PR tomorrow.

Ashley: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1103 — leaving notes in the diff for the autoscale naming change.

Chris: QA note: run `grep -R "redwood-dedicated"` in /docs root before merging (I removed three occurrences).

Maya: closing loop — once merged, I'll send a short announcement in #all-hands and update the release notes.

Kevin: :rocket:

DocBot: Thread archived after last message 1743221234.
